operation_key.description: Client-generated UUID persisted before the start request. Unique per org and reused only for identical input.

quote_revision.description: Opaque revision of the displayed quote; echo it when confirming.

buyer_fingerprint.description: Opaque revision of buyer details and email policy; never full VIES evidence.

currency.description: Every new quote is in EUR.

net_cents.description: Current charge excluding VAT, in cents.

vat_cents.description: VAT on the current charge, in cents.

gross_cents.description: Total to confirm, including VAT, in cents.

vat_treatment_line.const: Reverse charge — VAT payable by the recipient

app_user_packs.description: Packs of five extra app users.

live_video_packs.description: Packs of 250 extra hours of app-user live video per month.

robots.description: The robots that stay, by id. Every other robot is deleted when the change takes effect.

apps.description: The apps that stay, by id. Every other app is deleted when the change takes effect.

app_users.description: The app users that stay, by id, across every app. Every other app user is deleted when the change takes effect.

developers.description: The developers that stay, by user id, owners never among them: every owner stays. Every other developer is removed from the org when the change takes effect.
